fields.description: When Duty Drawback / RoDTEP is recognised as income. LEO is the usual choice because the entitlement is reasonably certain once the shipping bill carries the claim; confirm with your auditor.

On LEO

fields.description: Default validity used when recording an e-scrip. Check the validity printed on the scrip.
fields.label: RoDTEP Scrip Validity (Months)

fields.description: Period from shipment within which export proceeds must be realised under the RBI Master Direction in force. Update this if RBI changes it.
fields.label: Export Realisation Period (Months)

fields.description: Period from shipment within which import payments are expected to be settled.
fields.label: Import Payment Period (Months)
Ship Against Advance Within (Months)
fields.description: Period allowed by the RBI's Master Direction (or the export contract) to ship goods against an advance received. RBI has changed this period by notification, so check the current rule.
Exports without IGST (Overseas / SEZ) require a valid Letter of Undertaking for the invoice date.
fields.label: Check LUT on Zero-rated Exports
Merchant Export Within (Days)
fields.description: Goods bought at 0.1% GST for merchant export must be exported within this period from the supplier's invoice date.
BCD, SWS and other non-creditable duties computed on the Bill of Entry are moved into item valuation through a Landed Cost Voucher.
fields.label: Add Non-creditable Customs Duty to Stock Value
Pre-shipment Controls
fields.description: Checks on quotations, sales orders and export invoices: destination country risk, export policy of the goods (ITC-HS) and buyer screening.

fields.label: Pre-shipment Checks
fields.description: Block stops a sanctioned destination, prohibited goods or an unscreened buyer; Warn only shows a message. Restricted goods and SCOMET items always warn.

fields.label: Buyer Screening Valid For (Months)
fields.description: How long a denied-party screening of a buyer counts. 0 turns the screening check off.
